(1) AGENDA: The Commission will proceed through the agenda in order until the agenda is completed or unless the
    agenda items are reordered by the Chairperson or by majority vote of the Commission. The Commission may
    take action following presentation, public comment, and Commission discussion of those matters listed
    on the agenda. [Gov. Code §§ 11122, 11125 (a) and (b)].

(2) PUBLIC COMMENT
    (a) Public comment for agenda items: The Chairperson will entertain public comment as the Commission takes
        up agenda items. Individuals attending via Zoom wishing to comment on agenda items should use the
        “raise hand” feature in Zoom. Individuals attending in person should complete the green Public Comment –
        Agenda Items form and submit it to the Commission’s recording secretary. Generally, comments will be
        limited to three (3) minutes. However, depending on the amount of comments, the Chairperson, in their
        sole discretion may raise or reduce the time for comments.
    (b) Public comment period for items not on the agenda: Individuals attending via Zoom wishing to address the
        Commission on items not on the agenda during the public comment period should use the “raise hand”
        feature in Zoom. Individuals attending in person should complete the green Public Comment – Agenda
        Items form and submit it to the Commission’s recording secretary. Generally, comments will be limited to
        three (3) minutes. However, depending on the amount of comments, the Chairperson, in their sole
        discretion may raise or reduce the time for comments.
    (c) Written Materials and/or Visual Aids: Members of the public presenting written materials or visual aids as
        part of their public comments to the Commission are requested to submit material(s) to
        SPR.Commission@parks.ca.gov no later than Friday February 27, 2026. The Department is unable to
        accept files larger than 25MB. The Department reserves the right to decline to show photographs that
        violate personal privacy (photos without a release from person/people shown in photograph) or other valid
        reason in the opinion of the Department and its legal counsel. To remain in compliance with the American
        with Disabilities Act (ADA), Government Code section 11546.7, we are unable to post any documents that
        do not meet the requirements of the federal Rehabilitation Act, the ADA, and the Web Content Accessibility
        Guidelines. For more information, please visit Document Accessibility (ca.gov).

(3) CONSENT CALENDAR: The Commission may approve items on the Consent Calendar in a single motion
    without public comment. Any person may request that an item be removed from the Consent Calendar, to
    present public comment. Individuals attending via Zoom shall make such request by using the “raise hand”
    feature in Zoom. Individuals attending in person shall make such request by completing the green Public
    Comment – Agenda Items form and submitting it to the Commission’s recording secretary. If such a request
    is made, the item(s) shall be removed from the Consent Calendar and heard by the Commission as
    described in (2)(a) and (2)(c) above. The Commission welcomes comments on Consent Calendar items
    following approval. Any person wishing to address the Commission on a Consent Calendar item but not
    wishing to remove it from the Consent Calendar, shall follow the above-mentioned process for providing
